The NGC 2903 cutout is 3000 x 3000 px, 0.3333333 degrees wide, tangent projection on 143.04, +21.500556 through the CDS hips2fits service; 108 of the 121 Gaia DR3 stars brighter than G = 18.5 in it fall within 2.5 px of their requested places (median 0.5 px).

The M95 cutout is 3000 x 3000 px, 0.2 degrees wide, tangent projection on 160.990417, +11.703611 through the CDS hips2fits service; 53 of the 58 Gaia DR3 stars brighter than G = 19 in it have a star within 4 px of their requested places.

The NGC 4536 cutout is 2250 x 2250 px, 0.25 degrees wide (0.40 arcsec per pixel, the HiPS's scale), tangent projection on 188.612917, +2.188333 through the CDS hips2fits service; 70 of the 74 Gaia DR3 stars brighter than G = 19 in it have a star within 4 px of their requested places.

The NGC 4424 cutout is 1125 x 1125 px, 0.125 degrees wide, tangent projection on 186.798333, +9.420556 through the CDS hips2fits service; all 17 Gaia DR3 stars brighter than G = 19 in it have a star within 4 px of their requested places.

The NGC 4639 cutout is 900 x 900 px, 0.1 degrees wide, tangent projection on 190.718337, +13.257241 through the CDS hips2fits service; 8 of the 10 Gaia DR3 stars brighter than G = 19 in it have a star within 4 px of their requested places.
